about_the_game:
Become the Cryptid Keeper.

The Cryptid Catcher,

The Alien Wrangler,

The Adventurer!

Track, catch, and collect cryptids, monsters, and aliens. Manage your own Cryptid Zoo, care for your creatures, and attract visitors while exploring the wild to discover new and mysterious Cryptid species add to your Index.

Gameplay :

At it's core, a cosy RPG/Monster Collector, but with so much more...

  •  Embark on a curious adventure from your base-camp, where you'll radar-scan and hunt for Cryptids, Monsters and Aliens!

  • Use the tent to view and manage your Cryptid Index, craft hunting resources, view your Zoo stats and more...

  • Use your traps, cryptid pings and keen observation skills to track down and capture these elusive creatures.

  • Why? To add them to your Zoo of course! Open the gates, charge the visitors, maintain, feed, store and display your Cryptids. 

  • Don't forget to sort your Aliens in the Cosmos Center, making sure they have the correct atmosphere for their enclosures, enough food in their bellies, enough technological resources to keep them entertained, but not enough to engineer a galactic escape.

Whether you're a fan of cryptids, a lover of cosy games, or simply in need of a little magical adventure, you'll find joy in discovering and caring for your collection of cryptid companions.

Key Features:

  • Cryptid Hunting: Scan and search for cryptids, find them on the Map.

  • Customise Your Zoo: Capture cryptids and house them in your very own charming zoo.

  • Take Your Pick: Choose your best Creatures to display in your Zoo.

  • Collection & Discovery:  Find new cryptids and uncover their unique traits and behaviours. Explore the map, stumble upon strange encounters, investigate your radar-pings, set and bait traps, visit enterable locations, pick berries and leaves to craft items, find hunter caches and scavenge items, get ambushed by a Sasquatch... What will you find?

  • Get Lost in the Story: Story driven gameplay design.

  • Charming Art Style: Immerse yourself in a world of colourful visuals and sounds.

  • Fun Interactions: Observe, look after and interact with your cryptids in their new home.

Get ready to embark on a fun journey through the world of cryptids! The creatures are waiting for you to find them — can you capture them all?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual-Core CPU, 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 4000 or equivalent) or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: i5-6600K Processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1660
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
